I sit down with Jay and break down how he used ugc marketing for apps to drive massive organic tiktok growth and build a true predictable virality system from scratch.

Jay explains his exact viral hook strategy, how he optimized the 3 second retention metric, and why hitting a 75 percent watch rate was the turning point for consistent distribution. He shares how improving the 3 second retention metric directly increased his 75 percent watch rate, unlocking scalable organic tiktok growth.

We dive into how he used founder led content testing to refine messaging, overcome the cold start problem strategy, and achieve real social app growth without ads. This is the behind-the-scenes system that helped him go from zero traction to a bootstrapped app to 65k mrr.

Jay also details how he was able to scale with 60 creators using smart performance based cpm deals, why the 1 to 2 dollar cpm benchmark matters, and how to structure campaigns that align incentives for performance. His approach to ugc marketing for apps combined with a disciplined predictable virality system is what made everything repeatable.
